The ISIMIP3b projection (2015-2100), the delta bias correction and the
2011-2014 gap fill have been removed. This file only processes the GFDL-MOM6-COBALT2
obsclim series for 1961-2010.

## Set up directories

```{r setup_dirs, include=TRUE}
library(here)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here())

# Folder for all plankton outputs
save_dir <- file.path(here(), "Gfdl_Plankton Forcing", "plankton")
```

## Load required libraries

```{r libraries}
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)   # year(), dmy()
library(readr)       # read_csv()
library(ggplot2)
```

## Eastern Scotian Shelf plankton processing (GFDL obsclim, 1961-2010)

Converts monthly, grid-cell-level, vertically-integrated plankton stock
(mol C m-2) into an annual regional total (g wet weight) for five plankton
variables: diatoms, diazotrophs, picophytoplankton, mesozooplankton,
microzooplankton.

Source files are GFDL-MOM6-COBALT2 obsclim. The `-vint` suffix means they were
already vertically integrated over all ocean levels by the ISIMIP data
management team (units: mol m-2). There is no depth column and no total_area
column.

Region area (146,360,555,008 m^2, Eastern Scotian Shelf) was confirmed from the
FishMIP pipeline's own output metadata (`total_area`, `area_units = "m2"`).

```{r process-fn}
# Region area, Eastern Scotian Shelf (m^2)
region_area_m2 <- 146360555008

# Process one GFDL obsclim "-vint" plankton file:
#   monthly grid cells -> monthly regional mean -> annual mean -> region total
process_gfdl_vint <- function(file_path, var_label, region_area_m2,
                              out_dir = save_dir) {
  df <- read_csv(file_path, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    mutate(date = as.Date(substr(time, 1, 10)))

  # Unweighted mean across all grid cells, per month
  monthly_mean <- df |>
    group_by(date) |>
    summarise(mean_val = mean(vals, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  # Annual mean of the monthly values (mol m-2)
  annual_mean <- monthly_mean |>
    mutate(year = year(date)) |>
    group_by(year) |>
    summarise(val = mean(mean_val, na.rm = TRUE), n_months = n(), .groups = "drop")

  # Warn if any year is incomplete; its annual mean would be seasonally biased
  if (any(annual_mean$n_months != 12)) {
    warning(var_label, ": years with fewer than 12 months: ",
            paste(annual_mean$year[annual_mean$n_months != 12], collapse = ", "),
            call. = FALSE)
  }

  # mol C m-2 -> gC m-2 -> g wet weight m-2 -> region total (g wet weight)
  # NOTE: the *10 (carbon -> wet weight) factor was set for phytoplankton
  # (Diat/Diaz/Pico). Confirm whether Zmeso/Zmicro need a different
  # conversion factor before trusting those two outputs quantitatively.
  val_total <- annual_mean$val * 12.011 * 10 * region_area_m2
  out_df <- data.frame(Year = annual_mean$year, val = val_total)
  names(out_df) <- c("Year", var_label)   # base R naming avoids tidy-eval issues

  if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  out_file <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("gfdl-mom6-cobalt2_obsclim_", var_label,
    "-vint_15arcmin_eastern-scotian-shelf_annual_1961_2010.csv"))
  write.table(out_df, out_file, row.names = FALSE, col.names = TRUE,
              quote = FALSE, sep = ",")
  out_df
}
```

```{r run-all}
in_dir <- "Gfdl_Plankton Forcing/Plankton_data"
in_file <- function(v) {
  file.path(in_dir, paste0("gfdl-mom6-cobalt2_obsclim_", v,
    "-vint_15arcmin_eastern-scotian-shelf_monthly_1961_2010.csv"))
}

diat_1961_2010   <- process_gfdl_vint(in_file("phydiat"), "Diat",   region_area_m2)
diaz_1961_2010   <- process_gfdl_vint(in_file("phydiaz"), "Diaz",   region_area_m2)
pico_1961_2010   <- process_gfdl_vint(in_file("phypico"), "Pico",   region_area_m2)
zmeso_1961_2010  <- process_gfdl_vint(in_file("zmeso"),   "Zmeso",  region_area_m2)
zmicro_1961_2010 <- process_gfdl_vint(in_file("zmicro"),  "Zmicro", region_area_m2)
```


```{r combine}
# =============================================================================
# Plankton spin-up, 1861-1960: repeat the first n_cycle real years (1961-1970).
#
# Needs in the session:
#   plankton_all : Year, val, variable (5 groups), 1961-2010
#
# 1861-1960 is constructed spin-up forcing, NOT data.
# =============================================================================
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)   # dmy()

# ---- Settings ----------------------------------------------------------------
n_cycle    <- 10L                  # years repeated: 1961-1970
spin_start <- 1861L
spin_end   <- 1960L
out_dir    <- "Ess_Fishmip_data"
stopifnot(dir.exists(out_dir))     # fails loudly if R is in the wrong folder

spin_years <- spin_start:spin_end
# Align the cycle backward from spin_end: 1960 <- 1970, 1959 <- 1969, ...
idx <- n_cycle - ((spin_end - spin_years) %% n_cycle)

# ---- Spin-up for one group (Year + val) ---------------------------------------
spin_up <- function(d) {
  d <- arrange(d, Year)
  stopifnot(min(d$Year) == spin_end + 1)           # real data must start right after
  spin <- d[seq_len(n_cycle), ][idx, ]
  spin$Year <- spin_years
  out <- bind_rows(spin, d)
  stopifnot(nrow(out) == length(spin_years) + nrow(d), !anyDuplicated(out$Year))
  out
}

plankton_full <- plankton_all %>%
  group_by(variable) %>%
  group_modify(~ spin_up(.x)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(variable, Year)

stopifnot(nrow(plankton_full) == 5 * 150)          # 5 groups x 1861-2010

# ---- Plot: one panel per group, spin-up shaded --------------------------------
p_plankton <- ggplot(plankton_full, aes(Year, val)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = spin_start, xmax = spin_end + 0.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           fill = "grey85", alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.5, colour = "darkgreen") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = spin_end + 0.5, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +   # groups differ by orders of magnitude
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1860, 2010, 30)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale())) +
  labs(title = "Plankton forcing, 1861-2010 (1861-1960 = repeated 1961-1970)",
       x = NULL, y = "Annual regional total (g wet weight)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10)
print(p_plankton)

ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "plankton_spinup_1861_2010.png"), p_plankton,
       width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)

# ---- Save one V1/V2 file per group (the format the resource script reads) ----
file_label <- c(Diatoms = "diat", Diazotrophs = "diaz", Picophytoplankton = "pico",
                Mesozooplankton = "meso", Microzooplankton = "micro")

for (v in names(file_label)) {
  d <- filter(plankton_full, variable == v)
  write.csv(data.frame(V1 = dmy(paste0("01-JAN-", d$Year)), V2 = d$val),
            file.path(out_dir, paste0("GFDL_obsclim_", file_label[[v]], "_1861_2010.csv")),
            row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
}
```
